products.description: 2 m air temperature (degC) and relative humidity (%), generated from SYNOP reports
hourly mean wind speed (m/s) from 10-minute means

meteo.accepted_time_references_note: Only series whose Metadaten_Parameter says UTC are used. 17 wind series of analogue-recording stations say MEZ; compared with their nearest UTC-labelled neighbours, their hourly values align best at offsets of -1 h (14 of 17 stations) and -2 or -3 h (3) after the documented MEZ->UTC conversion, against 0 h among UTC-labelled neighbours, so their clock cannot be verified and they are excluded rather than guessed.
